description: Star Relay joins the site arcade: a turn-based grid puzzle that twists relays to link the reactor to the beacon across six quiet levels, with the games index listing both games.
lead: The arcade grows a second shelf. Star Relay is a turn-based relay puzzle with a move budget and no timer, and the games index lists it beside the first game. Everything is vanilla script and tokens, with hashed same-origin assets and no network calls.
